# Third-party source dependencies

`metadrive/` is an editable clone of [`metadriverse/metadrive`](https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive). It is intentionally ignored by this repository; clone it locally before running `uv sync`:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/metadriverse/metadrive.git third_party/metadrive
```

Record the checked-out commit alongside each experiment so its simulator behavior can be reproduced.

The local clone is currently pinned to `85e5dadc6c7436d324348f6e3d8f8e680c06b4db`.
